title: Area, hue, and opacity
text: A keyboard-operable 2D area with hue and optional opacity sliders that follow the reading direction.

title: Typed values
text: Hex, rgb(), and hsl() text with validation; the value is always normalized hex.

title: Swatches with names
text: App-supplied presets and recent colors, each with a spoken name.

title: Contrast hint
text: The WCAG contrast ratio against a background with an AA and AAA verdict.

title: Eyedropper where available
text: Feature-detected screen color picking; the button is hidden where the browser lacks it.

title: Popup or inline
text: A trigger with the current color opens a dialog, or the panel sits in the page.
